    The boundary idempotent and Iyama saturation #

    The boundary projective generator U is a retract of the full surviving additive generator G. Its projector defines an idempotent e in the factor Auslander ring (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ, and the represented module Hom(G,U) is the principal left ideal Γ e.

    Together with IdempotentSaturation, this translates Iyama's condition HomΓ(Hom(G,U), M/L) = 0 into the explicit condition that e annihilates the quotient. The next layer will apply this saturation to the lifted image inside the represented full-support projective.
